turns.text: Hello, I am Kavach Saathi, an AI assistant from Kavach — not the police or government, Please tell me what happened,

I am facing a online fraud that I have did a transaction day before yesterday, which got failed. But then the person in front is asking me again for the money. It was around 10000 rupees, 2 days back.
I am sorry to hear that. First, what may I call you?
प्रणव,

Thank you, Pranav. Since this happened very recently, please call 1930 and your bank's fraud number as soon as this call ends, or right now if you prefer. To help me understand, how did you try to send this 10,000 rupees—was it through an app, a card, or
भाई,
Sorry, buy card.
Got it, Pranav. You tried to send the money by card. Did you receive any transaction reference number or message when the transaction failed?
Yeah, I have the documents. I have the screenshot.
Great, having those screenshots will be helpful. Did the person asking for the money contact you through a specific number, email, or app?
Contacted me through email.
Thank you for sharing that, Pranav. Keep those emails as evidence. Is there anything else you still have, like call logs or other messages, that might help?
No, nothing of that's all.
Alright, Pranav. Have you already contacted your bank or reported this to cybercrime.gov.in or the police?
No no no steps has been taken till now. That's why I have come to the steps.
Understood, Pranav. Please make sure to report this to your bank and on cybercrime.gov.in as soon as possible. It's important to take these steps quickly. What would you like to happen next?
Nothing less. To take my money back into my account.

I understand, Pranav. While I can't promise recovery, reporting to your bank and cybercrime.gov.in is the best step to take for a chance at getting your money back. Is there anything else you need help with?
No no, thank you.

Alright, Pranav. Remember, nothing has been filed with the police, a bank, or any government portal yet. The full conversation is on your screen to check. Take care, and remember to reach out again if you need more help. Goodbye!

extracted.chronology_draft: On 2026-09-03, the user attempted a transaction of 10,000 INR via card which failed. The suspect is now pressuring the user for the money via email.

summary: Pranav reported a failed card transaction of 10,000 INR from two days ago, noting that a suspect is now pressuring him for payment via email. The agent advised him to report the incident immediately to his bank and the national cybercrime portal (1930). No prior reports have been filed, and the user was instructed on the necessary steps for potential recovery.
